name: Tests

on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  unit_tests:
    name: unit tests
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            url: https://github.com/neovim/neovim/releases/download/nightly/nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
            manager: sudo snap
            packages: go
          - os: ubuntu-22.04
            url: https://github.com/neovim/neovim/releases/download/stable/nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
            manager: sudo snap
            packages: go
          - os: ubuntu-22.04
            url: https://github.com/neovim/neovim/releases/download/v0.11.0/nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
            manager: sudo snap
            packages: go
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: "^1.24.0" # The Go version to download (if necessary) and use.
      - run: date +%F > todays-date
      - name: Restore cache for today's nightly.
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: _neovim
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-${{ matrix.url }}-${{ hashFiles('todays-date') }}

      - name: Prepare
        run: |
          ${{ matrix.manager }} install --classic ${{ matrix.packages }}
          # sudo apt install go
          test -d _neovim || {
            mkdir -p _neovim
            curl -sL ${{ matrix.url }} | tar xzf - --strip-components=1 -C "${PWD}/_neovim"
          }
          GO111MODULE=on go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@latest

          mkdir -p ~/.local/share/nvim/site/pack/vendor/start
          git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/nvim-lua/plenary.nvim ~/.local/share/nvim/site/pack/vendor/start/plenary.nvim
          git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/ray-x/guihua.lua ~/.local/share/nvim/site/pack/vendor/start/guihua.lua
          git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/nvim-treesitter/nvim-treesitter ~/.local/share/nvim/site/pack/vendor/start/nvim-treesitter
          git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/kyazdani42/nvim-web-devicons ~/.local/share/nvim/site/pack/vendor/start/nvim-web-devicons
          git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig ~/.local/share/nvim/site/pack/vendor/start/nvim-lspconfig
          ln -s $(pwd) ~/.local/share/nvim/site/pack/vendor/start
      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          export PATH="${PWD}/_neovim/bin:${PATH}"
          nvim --headless -u tests/minimal.vim -c "TSInstallSync go" -c "q"
          make test

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
